parts.name: Drop-In Lite Panel Mount Block
parts.description: Black injection-molded nylon block that mounts a panel either flush with the profile edge or on the profile surface. A molded extension drops into the T-slot and serves as a T-slot stud; this version has a M6 x 1.0 thread.
features: Mounts panel flush with profile edge or on profile surface
Molded extension serves as T-slot stud
Spacer block can be used (pg. 5-33)
parts.notes: Row is badged 15 and 40 (metric 40 series). Required machining service: Panel Mount Block Milling on the mounting panel (reference page 11-42). A spacer block can be used (pg. 5-33).
